## 1. Project security level

- **Level**: HIGH
- **Lý do**: Project xử lý payment (VNPAY custom gateway + Mollie), PII khách hàng (email, address VN), checkout flow. VNPAY là custom code (IPN/signature) — chưa security review. Magento 2.4.8 storefront cho thị trường VN fashion.

## 2. Secrets & credentials

- Secret storage: [TBD — prod: env/secret manager; KHÔNG commit vào repo] · Local-dev config trong `env.php`
- Secret types trong project: DB password · VNPAY TmnCode + hash secret · Mollie API key + webhook · SMTP credentials · Hyvä Packagist token (`auth.json`) · payment gateway keys
- Rotation policy: [TBD]
- Rule: không bao giờ paste secret vào prompt/code/log/commit (Hard Gate — `core/production-ai-security.md` §6)

## 3. Shell command safety

- Sanctioned command allowlist: `bin/magento`, `composer`, `npm`/`npx`, `vendor/bin/phpunit`, tailwind build (`npm run build` / `build-prod`)
- Destructive verbs require human approval: `rm -rf`, `DROP`, `TRUNCATE`, bulk `DELETE/UPDATE`, `bin/magento setup:upgrade` trên prod, `cache:flush` prod
- Production CLI: [TBD — chỉ human-initiated; qua CI/CD hoặc VPN; phụ thuộc DEC-2/DEC-3]
- Rule: không string-interpolate untrusted data vào command (§3)

## 4. Dependencies

- Package sources: Packagist official + Hyvä private Packagist (`auth.json` token) + Magento Marketplace. Mageplaza modules committed as source (`app/code/Mageplaza`) — KHÔNG modify in place, extend via plugin/preference.
- New dependency → TL approval (Hard Gate) + provenance/advisory check (§4, §7)
- Pin versions cho production: `composer.lock` committed; theme lockfile cho tailwind toolchain
- Known vulnerable dep: [TBD — chạy `composer audit` + review advisory khi setup CI/CD]

## 5. Payment / checkout / order / auth / PII

- **Payment gateway**:
  - **VNPAY** — custom `Vnpayment_VNPAY` (default inactive) · controllers `Order/Pay`, `Order/Info`, `Order/Ipn` · auth = TmnCode + hash secret · sandbox/testing: [TBD — VNPAY sandbox]
  - **Mollie** 3.1.1 — active · Hyvä compat bundle · auth = API key + webhook · test mode: [TBD]
- **PII handled**: email, tên, SĐT, Vietnam address (quốc gia/tỉnh-thành/phường-xã) — masking: [TBD — log masking cho PII]
- **Auth mechanism**: Magento customer session + Mageplaza SocialLogin (OAuth) — high-risk change → Tier 2 escalation
- **Production-sensitive areas** (từ blueprint §12): `Vnpayment_VNPAY` (IPN/signature), Mageplaza OSC checkout, `Secomm_AddressDropdown` + `VietNamAddress` (data + GraphQL surface). Mọi change các area này require SA review + security-review checklist.
